Name: GlassGrid You
Author: GlassGrid You
Description: Control playback, Mini-Player, Ghost Mode, Multiview grid, A-B Loop, bookmarks, and Stream Deck+ dials in GlassGrid You over local Streamable HTTP MCP.

Actions.Name: Play / Pause
Actions.Tooltip: Toggle play/pause on the active video or target Multiview slot.

Actions.Name: Mute / Unmute
Actions.Tooltip: Toggle audio mute on the active video or target Multiview slot.

Actions.Name: Mini-Player
Actions.Tooltip: Toggle the always-on-top Floating Mini-Player or Floating Multiview Grid.

Actions.Name: Ghost Mode
Actions.Tooltip: Toggle click-through Ghost Mode on the Floating Mini-Player.

Actions.Name: Multiview
Actions.Tooltip: Toggle Multiview grid mode in the active GlassGrid You window.

Actions.Name: Sync All
Actions.Tooltip: Synchronize all active Multiview tiles to live edge or primary VOD timestamp.

Actions.Name: Solo Tile
Actions.Tooltip: Toggle Solo Tile zoom for a configured Multiview slot (1-4).

Actions.Name: Focus Audio
Actions.Tooltip: Switch exclusive Multiview audio focus to a configured slot (1-4).

Actions.Name: Add Bookmark
Actions.Tooltip: Save a timestamped bookmark for the active video (requires Full Control).

Actions.Name: Toggle A-B Loop
Actions.Tooltip: Toggle, set A/B, or clear the A-B loop range on the active video.

Actions.Name: Media Dial (Seek / Volume / Frame)
Actions.Tooltip: Rotate to scrub timeline, adjust volume, or step video frames; press to cycle mode or tap to toggle play/pause.

TriggerDescription.Rotate: Scrub timeline, adjust volume, or step frames
